updates.application_process:
How to apply

  1. Open the official portal and confirm that the 2027 cycle is live.
  2. Read the current bulletin, eligibility rules and document checklist.
  3. Register with an accessible email address and mobile number.
  4. Enter academic, category and identity details exactly as shown on your documents.
  5. Upload the required files, pay through the authorised gateway and save the confirmation page.
  6. Use the same login for corrections, admit card, answer key, result and counselling notices.

Apply on the official portal · Read the official notification page

The authority has not released the complete 2027 schedule yet. We show an explicit pending status instead of copying 2026 dates or publishing an estimate.
updates.exam_pattern:
Exam pattern

The Maharashtra State CET Cell will publish the 2027 groups, attempts, shifts, marking, normalisation and CAP process. Engineering, pharmacy and agriculture routes should not be mixed together on one generic page.

Question counts, marking, shifts and accessibility rules can change. The latest official bulletin overrides every older coaching summary.
updates.preparation_tips:
How to prepare

  • Start with the authority-published syllabus and make a topic checklist.
  • Practise in the same mode and time limits as the actual paper.
  • After each mock, separate concept gaps from reading, calculation and time-management mistakes.
  • Keep an error log and revise it weekly.
  • Track form, admit-card and counselling deadlines separately from study tasks.

Thoda-thoda consistent work is easier to sustain than a last-week rush.
updates.counselling_content:
After the exam

A score or rank is not an admission offer. Follow the counselling or institute portal named by the authority, check category and document rules, fill choices carefully and pay only through the authorised payment page.
updates.result_content:
Result and scorecard

Download the scorecard only from the official candidate login. Save the PDF and note the score, rank, validity and next admission step. If a date is not published, it remains marked as pending.
